verses.text: Give thanks to di Lord, because e good, because im faithful love dey forever.
Make Israel talk now, “Im faithful love dey forever.”
Make di house of Aaron talk now, “Im faithful love dey forever.”
Make dem wey fear di Lord talk now, “Im faithful love dey forever.”
Out of my distress I call on di Lord. Di Lord answer me and set me free.
Di Lord dey with me. I no go fear. Wetin man fit do to me?
Di Lord dey with me as my helper. Therefore I go see my desire on dem wey hate me.
E better to take refuge for di Lord pass to put confidence for man.
E better to take refuge for di Lord pass to put confidence for princes.
All nations surround me, but for di name of di Lord I go cut dem off.
Dem surround me, yes, dem surround me, but for di name of di Lord I go cut dem off.
Dem surround me like bees. Dem dey quenched like fire of thorns. For di name of di Lord I go cut dem off.
You push me hard so dat I fall, but di Lord help me.
Di Lord na my strength and song. E don become my salvation.
Di voice of joy and salvation dey for di tents of di righteous. Di right hand of di Lord dey do valiantly.
Di right hand of di Lord dey exalted. Di right hand of di Lord dey do valiantly.
I no go die, but live, and declare di works of di Lord.
Di Lord don punish me severely, but e no give me over to death.
Open to me di gates of righteousness. I go enter into dem. I go give thanks to di Lord.
Dis na di gate of di Lord. Di righteous go enter into am.
I go give thanks to you, because you don answer me. You don become my salvation.
Di stone wey di builders reject don become di cornerstone.
Dis na di Lord work. E dey marvelous for our eyes.
Dis na di day wey di Lord don make. We go rejoice and dey glad for am.
Save now, we beg you, Lord. Lord, we beg you, make us prosper now.
Blessed be im wey dey come for di name of di Lord. We don bless una from di house of di Lord.
Di Lord na God, and e don shine im light on us. Bind di festival sacrifice with cords, even to di horns of di altar.
You be my God, and I go give thanks to you. You be my God, I go exalt you.
Give thanks to di Lord, because e good, because im faithful love dey forever.
Blessed na dem wey dey blameless for di way, wey dey waka for di law of di Lord.
Blessed na dem wey keep im statutes, wey seek am with all dem heart,
wey no dey do wickedness, but waka for im ways.
You don command your precepts, make we keep dem diligently.
Oh, make my ways dey firm to keep your statutes.
Den I no go shame, when I consider all your commandments.
I go thank you with upright heart, when I don learn your righteous judgments.
I go keep your statutes. No forsake me completely.
How young man go keep im way pure? By living according to your word.
With my whole heart I don seek you. No make me wander from your commandments.
I don store your word for my heart, so dat I no go sin against you.
Blessed be you, Lord. Teach me your statutes.
With my lips I don declare all di judgments of your mouth.
I rejoice for di way of your testimonies, as much as for all riches.
I go meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.
I go delight for your statutes. I no go forget your word.
Deal bountifully with your servant, so dat I go live and keep your word.
Open my eyes, so dat I go see wonderful things out of your law.
I be stranger for di earth. No hide your commandments from me.
My soul break with longing for your judgments at all times.
You rebuke di proud, wey dey cursed, wey stray from your commandments.
Take away reproach and contempt from me, because I don keep your testimonies.
Even though princes sit and talk against me, your servant go meditate on your statutes.
Yes, your testimonies na my delight and my counselors.
My soul dey cling to di dust. Revive me according to your word.
I don declare my ways, and you answer me. Teach me your statutes.
Make me understand di way of your precepts. Den I go meditate on your wonderful works.
My soul dey melt for grief. Strengthen me according to your word.
Remove di way of lying from me. Graciously teach me your law.
I don choose di way of faithfulness. I don set your judgments before me.
I cling to your testimonies, Lord. No put me to shame.
I go run di path of your commandments, when you don enlarge my heart.
Teach me, Lord, di way of your statutes. I go keep am to di end.
Give me understanding, and I go keep your law. Yes, I go obey am with my whole heart.
Make me waka for di path of your commandments, because I delight for am.
Turn my heart to your testimonies, no to selfish gain.
Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things. Revive me for your way.
Establish your word to your servant, so dat e go dey for dem wey fear you.
Turn away my reproach wey I dey fear, because your judgments dey good.
Look, I long for your precepts. Revive me for your righteousness.
Make your faithful love come to me, Lord, your salvation according to your word.
So I go get answer for am wey dey reproach me, because I trust for your word.
No take di word of truth completely out of my mouth, because I hope for your ordinances.
So I go keep your law continually, forever and ever.
I go waka for wide place, because I don seek your precepts.
I go speak of your testimonies before kings and no go shame.
I go delight for your commandments, wey I love.
I go lift up my hands to your commandments, wey I love. I go meditate on your statutes.
Remember di word to your servant, because you don make me hope.
Dis na my comfort for my affliction, say your word don revive me.
Di proud don mock me plenty, but I no turn away from your law.
I remember your ordinances from of old, Lord, and I dey comforted.
Hot anger don seize me because of di wicked wey forsake your law.
Your statutes don be my songs for di house wey I dey stay as stranger.
I remember your name for night, Lord, and I keep your law.
Dis don be mine, because I keep your precepts.
Di Lord na my portion. I don promise to keep your words.
I don seek your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
I consider my ways and turn my feet to your testimonies.
I hurry and no delay to keep your commandments.
Di cords of di wicked wrap round me, but I no forget your law.
For midnight I go rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous judgments.
I be friend to all dem wey fear you, and to dem wey keep your precepts.
Di earth, Lord, full of your faithful love. Teach me your statutes.
You don deal well with your servant, Lord, according to your word.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge, because I believe your commandments.
Before I dey afflicted, I go astray, but now I keep your word.
You dey good and do good. Teach me your statutes.
Di proud don smear me with lies. I keep your precepts with my whole heart.
Dem heart dey fat like grease, but I delight for your law.
E good for me say I dey afflicted, so dat I go learn your statutes.
Di law of your mouth better to me pass thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Your hands don make me and form me. Give me understanding, so dat I go learn your commandments.
Dem wey fear you go see me and rejoice, because I hope for your word.
Lord, I know say your judgments dey righteous, and say you don afflict me for faithfulness.
Make your faithful love comfort me, according to your word to your servant.
Make your tender mercies come to me, so dat I go live, because your law na my delight.
Make di proud dey ashamed, because dem don wrong me with lies, but I go meditate on your precepts.
Make dem wey fear you turn to me, and dem wey know your testimonies.
Make my heart dey blameless for your statutes, so dat I no go shame.
My soul faint for your salvation, but I hope for your word.
My eyes fail for your word. I talk say, “When you go comfort me?”
Because I don become like wineskin for smoke. Yet I no forget your statutes.
How many days your servant get? When you go execute judgment on dem wey persecute me?
Di proud don dig pits for me, dem wey no follow your law.
All your commandments dey faithful. Dem persecute me wrongly. Help me.
Dem almost finish me for di earth, but I no forsake your precepts.
Revive me according to your faithful love, so dat I go keep di testimony of your mouth.
Lord, your word dey settled forever for heaven.
Your faithfulness dey for all generations. You don establish di earth, and e stand.
Dem continue today according to your ordinances, because all things na your servants.
If your law no be my delight, I don perish for my affliction.
I no go ever forget your precepts, because with dem you don revive me.
I be your own. Save me, because I don seek your precepts.
Di wicked wait for me to destroy me, but I go consider your testimonies.
I don see say every perfection get end, but your commandment dey very wide.
Oh how I love your law! E be my meditation all day.
Your commandments make me wiser pass my enemies, because dem dey with me forever.
I get more understanding pass all my teachers, because your testimonies na my meditation.
I understand more pass di elders, because I keep your precepts.
I don hold back my feet from every evil way, so dat I go keep your word.
I no turn aside from your judgments, because you don teach me.
How sweet your words dey for my taste, sweeter pass honey to my mouth!
Through your precepts I get understanding, so I hate every false way.
Your word na lamp to my feet and light to my path.
I don swear, and I go confirm am, say I go keep your righteous judgments.
I dey afflicted very much. Revive me, Lord, according to your word.
Accept, I beg you, di willing offerings of my mouth, Lord, and teach me your judgments.
My soul dey for my hand continually, yet I no forget your law.
Di wicked don set snare for me, yet I no stray from your precepts.
I don take your testimonies as heritage forever, because dem na di joy of my heart.
I don set my heart to perform your statutes forever, to di end.
I hate double minded men, but I love your law.
You be my hiding place and my shield. I hope for your word.
Depart from me, una evildoers, so dat I go keep di commandments of my God.
Uphold me according to your word, so dat I go live. No make me dey ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I go dey safe, and I go always respect your statutes.
You reject all dem wey stray from your statutes, because dem deceit na falsehood.
You remove all di wicked of di earth like dross. So I love your testimonies.
My flesh tremble for fear of you. I dey afraid of your judgments.
I don do justice and righteousness. No leave me to my oppressors.
Guarantee your servant good. No let di proud oppress me.
My eyes fail for your salvation and for di word of your righteousness.
Deal with your servant according to your faithful love and teach me your statutes.
I be your servant. Give me understanding, so dat I go know your testimonies.
E don reach time for di Lord to act, because dem don break your law.
Therefore I love your commandments more pass gold, yes, more pass fine gold.
Therefore I consider all your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Your testimonies dey wonderful. So my soul keep dem.
Di entrance of your words give light. E give understanding to di simple.
I open my mouth wide and pant, because I long for your commandments.
Turn to me and have mercy on me, as e be di way for dem wey love your name.
Establish my steps for your word. No let any iniquity rule over me.
Redeem me from di oppression of man, so dat I go keep your precepts.
Make your face shine on your servant and teach me your statutes.
Streams of water run down my eyes, because dem no keep your law.
You dey righteous, Lord, and your judgments dey upright.
You don command your testimonies for righteousness and very great faithfulness.
My zeal don consume me, because my adversaries forget your words.
Your word dey very pure, so your servant love am.
I dey small and despised, yet I no forget your precepts.
Your righteousness na everlasting righteousness, and your law na truth.
Trouble and anguish don overtake me, yet your commandments na my delight.
Your testimonies dey righteous forever. Give me understanding, and I go live.
I cry with my whole heart. Answer me, Lord. I go keep your statutes.
I cry to you. Save me, and I go keep your testimonies.
I rise before dawn and cry for help. I hope for your words.
My eyes dey awake before di night watches, so dat I go meditate on your word.
Hear my voice according to your faithful love. Lord, revive me according to your ordinances.
Dem wey follow wicked plans near me. Dem dey far from your law.
You dey near, Lord, and all your commandments na truth.
Long ago I don learn from your testimonies say you don found dem forever.
Consider my affliction and deliver me, because I no forget your law.
Plead my cause and redeem me. Revive me according to your word.
Salvation dey far from di wicked, because dem no seek your statutes.
Your tender mercies dey great, Lord. Revive me according to your ordinances.
My persecutors and my adversaries plenty, yet I no turn away from your testimonies.
I look on di faithless with grief, because dem no keep your word.
Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Lord, according to your faithful love.
Di sum of your word na truth, and every one of your righteous ordinances dey forever.
Princes persecute me without cause, but my heart stand in awe of your words.
I rejoice for your word, like person wey find great spoil.
I hate and detest falsehood. I love your law.
Seven times every day I praise you because of your righteous judgments.
Great peace dey for dem wey love your law. Nothing go make dem stumble.
I don hope for your salvation, Lord, and I don do your commandments.
My soul don keep your testimonies. I love dem greatly.
I keep your precepts and testimonies, because all my ways dey before you.
Make my cry come near before you, Lord. Give me understanding according to your word.
Make my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
Make my lips pour out praise, because you teach me your statutes.
Make my tongue sing of your word, because all your commandments na righteousness.
Make your hand dey ready to help me, because I don choose your precepts.
I long for your salvation, Lord. Your law na my delight.
Make my soul live, and e go praise you. Make your ordinances help me.
I don go astray like lost sheep. Seek your servant, because I no forget your commandments.
For my distress I cry to di Lord, and e answer me.
Deliver my soul, Lord, from lying lips, from deceitful tongue.
Wetin e go give you? Wetin more e go add to you, you deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows of di warrior, with coals of juniper.
Woe to me, because I dey stay for Meshech, because I dey live among di tents of Kedar!
My soul don stay too long with dem wey hate peace.
I want peace, but when I speak, dem want war.
I lift up my eyes to di mountains. Where my help go come from?
My help dey come from di Lord, wey make heaven and earth.
E no go allow your foot slip. Di one wey keep you no go sleep.
Look, di one wey keep Israel no go slumber or sleep.
Di Lord na your keeper. Di Lord na your shade on your right hand.
Di sun no go strike you for day, nor di moon for night.
Di Lord go keep you from all evil. E go keep your soul.
Di Lord go keep your going out and your coming in from dis time forth and forevermore.

chapters.title: A song of ascents. By David.

verses.text: I glad when dem talk to me say, “Make we go to di house of di Lord.”
Our feet don dey stand inside your gates, Jerusalem,
Jerusalem, wey dem build as city wey join together,
where di tribes go up, di tribes of di Lord, as testimony to Israel, to give thanks to di name of di Lord.
Because di thrones of judgment dey set dere, di thrones of di house of David.
Pray for di peace of Jerusalem. Make dem wey love you prosper.
Make peace dey inside your walls and prosperity inside your palaces.
For my brothers and my friends sake, I go talk say, “Peace dey inside you.”
For di sake of di house of di Lord our God, I go seek your good.
To you I lift up my eyes, you wey sit enthroned for di heavens.
Look, as di eyes of servants dey look to di hand of dem oga, as di eyes of servant girl to di hand of dem oga woman, so our eyes dey look to di Lord our God, until e show us mercy.
Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, because we don get plenty contempt.
Our soul don get plenty scorn from dem wey dey at ease, and contempt from di proud.

chapters.title: A song of ascents. By David.

verses.text: If e no be di Lord wey dey for our side, make Israel talk now,
if e no be di Lord wey dey for our side, when men rise up against us,
den dem don swallow us alive, when dem anger burn against us.
Den di waters don overwhelm us, di stream don go over our soul.
Den di proud waters don go over our soul.
Blessed be di Lord, wey no give us as prey to dem teeth.
Our soul don escape like bird out of di snare of di fowlers. Di snare don break, and we don escape.
Our help dey for di name of di Lord, wey make heaven and earth.
Dem wey trust di Lord be like Mount Zion, wey no fit shake, but dey forever.
As mountains dey round Jerusalem, so di Lord dey round im people from dis time forth and forevermore.
Because di scepter of wickedness no go rest for di land wey belong to di righteous, so dat di righteous no go put dem hands to evil.
Do good, Lord, to dem wey dey good, and to dem wey dey upright for dem heart.
But as for dem wey turn aside to dem crooked ways, di Lord go lead dem away with di workers of iniquity. Peace dey on Israel.
When di Lord bring back di captives to Zion, we be like dem wey dream.
Den our mouth full of laughter, and our tongue with singing. Den dem talk among di nations say, “Di Lord don do great things for dem.”
Di Lord don do great things for us, and we dey glad.
Restore our fortunes again, Lord, like streams for di Negev.
Dem wey sow with tears go reap with songs of joy.
Dem wey go out dey weep, dey carry seed for sowing, go come home again with joy, dey carry dem sheaves.

chapters.title: A song of ascents. By Solomon.

verses.text: Except di Lord build di house, dem wey build am dey labor for nothing. Except di Lord watch over di city, di watchman dey stay awake for nothing.
E dey vain for una to rise early, to stay up late, to eat bread of hard work, because e dey give im beloved sleep.
Look, pikin dem na heritage from di Lord, di fruit of di womb im reward.
Like arrows for di hand of warrior, so na pikin dem of youth.
Blessed na di man wey fill im quiver with dem. Dem no go shame when dem speak with enemies for di gate.
